hardware.grace_available_note: Per-node MemAvailable is not exposed. Aggregate Linux MemTotal/MemAvailable includes HBM and is not Grace capacity.

measurement.video: 121 frames at 24 fps; 5.04 second encoded clip; 1280x704 or 832x480. Client wall includes queue, module transfers, denoising, decoding and MP4 assembly; warmed resident service; download/startup excluded. Real Factory automatic short Live build starts first and has observed simultaneous gateway inference.
measurement.memory: NVML memory_v2 used/free/reserved at approximately 10 Hz. Peak means maximum observed sample, not a continuous hardware trace; Torch allocator peaks recorded separately. Backends/creative loaded flags probed every two seconds.
measurement.creative_residency: One process owns FLUX and Wan; idle modules remain loaded in Grace CPU memory using model CPU offload; only one creative GPU job runs at a time. FLUX is CPU resident while Wan renders, not simultaneously GPU resident. DeepSeek/Qwen stay GPU resident.
measurement.reserve: Only this creative process receives a dynamic Torch allocation budget leaving 10 GiB reserve plus 4 GiB guard. CPU allocations bound to Grace node 0 per worker thread, no host-wide policy change. Existing engine fractions/contexts/sequences/gateway admission unchanged.
